content_findings.claim: Any other verdict prints the one command to run first.
content_findings.truth: Every verdict prints a `next:` line, but for several verdicts that line is not a command. GATE-RUNNING-WAIT says to wait and run nothing. NO-REMOTE says to ask the owner. PUSH-HOLD-STOP says to commit locally only because the owner lifts holds. GATE-FAILED-STOP says to read .gate/last.json, fix the cause, commit and re-gate. Only some verdicts give a single command (REGATE, PUSH, ROUND-DUE, DIRTY-COMMIT-FIRST, DIVERGED-STOP).
